title: Measurement specs for the six rails that have never been scored anywhere in Texas
status: FULL CLOSE on the specs, HONEST PARTIAL on validation. All six specs are written, frozen and tested; the branch is pushed, the PR is open and CI is green. What is NOT done, and cannot be from this lane, is an end-to-end run through a real scorer, because no scorer for these rails exists. That is SS-W12's capability and this record is what it should be told to compute.
missionPremise: OPS-16 amendment A-020, ruled 2026-08-19. Six of fourteen rails carry zero rows in county_facet_coverage and are therefore permanently not-yet on the console no matter what the store holds. VERIFIED by this lane against cortex at 16:20Z: the table holds exactly nine facet values (cad, envelope, flood, geometry, land-use, landuse, mud, owner, zoning) and roads, footprint, easement, rrc-wells, rrc-pipelines and rail-corridor are none of them. That is 1,524 of 3,556 cells, 42.9% of the manifest grid, with 35,159,990 atom rows behind a ledger no recompute can move. The split between this lane and SS-W12 exists because the last comparable programme built twelve writers and three scorers and nobody ever wrote down what scoring a rail meant.
completionPredicate: A stranger can (1) read packages/retrieval/src/rail-scoring-spec/README.md and, for each of the six rails, state its unit of coverage, what counts as covered, what counts as an established absence, what counts as not-yet, and the denominator with the rule that produced it; (2) import RAIL_SCORING_SPEC_BY_KEY and scoreCell and score a cell without opening this lane's notes; (3) run `pnpm exec vitest run src/rail-scoring-spec` from packages/retrieval and get 37 passing tests proving every guard can fire; and (4) re-derive any ceiling the specs rely on from the query written inside them. All four hold today.
scopeBasis: The dispatch scoped this lane to the six rails with zero ledger rows and explicitly excluded building scorers. The other eight rails already carry ledger rows and are out of scope. Fixing railCoverageCapability.ts and railEngineBinding.ts is out of scope because both are legacy-design-tools files that lane SS-W12 is working in; both are wrong and both are filed as findings instead. Re-adjudicating the standing RRC-wells memory is out of scope because it is an operator ruling; the evidence is supplied and the call is not mine. Statewide recounting of the WRITTEN layer is out of scope because SS-W9 measured it four hours before this lane started and the two figures I independently re-measured reproduce to the atom.

theSixSpecs.countingRuleForEveryPercentageBelow: (covered + established-absent) / denominator, where the denominator is every parcel-node atom in the county for the four parcel rails; roads and easement do not produce a percentage and say so

roads.unit: the OSM way, NOT the parcel
roads.covered: there is no per-parcel roads determination. road-node entity ids are <fips>:road:<osmWayId>, and PARCEL_KEYED_PROPERTY_ENTITY_TYPES explicitly EXCLUDES road-node (packages/atoms/src/property-instances.ts line 213). The only per-parcel road relation in the store is property-boundary-edge, which is not a rail and exists in exactly ONE county: 26,846 edges over 3,732 parcels, all Bastrop 48021
roads.establishedAbsence: NONE EXISTS. The writer emits no county-coverage absence for roads, so a county with no queryable roads is indistinguishable in the store from a county never attempted
roads.notYet: zero road-node atoms with the county's entity_id prefix
roads.denominator: ways the pinned Geofabrik Texas PBF yields inside the county boundary after the taxonomy filter. PERSISTED NOWHERE. It exists only inside a writer run, in an optional --out summary JSON written to a path of the operator's choosing. Cortex holds no road table of any kind
roads.ceiling: 254, re-derived from tx_county_boundary which holds 254 rows. The ledger publishes null with basis 'no capability probe defined for this rail', which is honest about having no probe and must not be read as a zero

footprint.covered: the parcel holds a building-footprint atom with no 'absence' key in the body
footprint.establishedAbsence: absence.kind = 'no-footprint-feature' with a reason naming the join threshold. A real determination: the staged geometry-true join ran against a real parcel ring and no candidate cleared it
footprint.notYet: the parcel is rostered and holds no building-footprint atom of either shape. 80 of 254 counties, and not one metro is among the 174 that do hold atoms
footprint.denominator: parcel-node atoms in the county, with a second measured figure against usable txgio prop_ids and a THIRD source-side figure (staged features joined over staged features available) that no other rail in this set supports
footprint.ceiling: 254, and the hardcode is right for the wrong reason. tx_building_footprint holds 10,674,975 footprints over 254 distinct county_fips INCLUDING the metros (Harris 895,154, Dallas 656,706, Travis 73,394, Bastrop 65,974), all of which hold zero footprint ATOMS. The gap is the O(fp x parcels) join, not staging and not reach

easement.unit: HYBRID. County for 252 of 254 counties, parcel for two
easement.covered: in a present-data county only. resolveCountyEasementRoute returns a non-honest-absence route for exactly TWO: McLennan 48309 at county scope and Bastrop 48021 at city-limits scope
easement.establishedAbsence: TWO shapes at two granularities. In an honest-absence county it is ONE atom for the WHOLE COUNTY carrying verifiedAbsence.provenanceScope. The planner's own comment is explicit that this is deliberate: 'Unincorporated parcels rely on this at serve time, not millions of per-parcel sentinels'
easement.notYet: the county holds neither a county-coverage absence nor any per-parcel easement atom. All 254 counties today
easement.denominator: TWO, never merged: 1 determination per county over 254 in the county regime, and the parcel-roster denominator restricted to present-data counties in the parcel regime. Reporting one blended percentage is a category error
easement.ceiling: acquisition 2, determination 254. This is the rail that proves the two ceilings must be separate; bounding easement absences by its acquisition reach would be the mud 209/186 defect with the sign flipped

rrc-wells.covered: the parcel holds a well-fact atom whose entity_id does NOT end ':none'. One atom is one (parcel, well) association: a single well within the 152 m radius of eight parcels produces eight atoms, so atom rows are neither wells nor parcels
rrc-wells.establishedAbsence: a well-fact atom ending ':none', absence.kind 'no-well-on-or-near', reason naming the 152 m radius. Emitted only after the bbox prefilter and the point-in-polygon plus distance test have both run against real geometry
rrc-wells.notYet: the parcel is rostered and holds no well-fact atom of either shape. 80 of 254 counties, INCLUDING Harris 48201, which is the one county the published ceiling names
rrc-wells.denominator: parcel-node atoms in the county, with the usable-prop_id writer-reach figure beside it

rrc-pipelines.unit: the parcel, one atom per parcel, entity_id is the bare parcelNodeId
rrc-pipelines.covered: the parcel holds an rrc-pipeline-fact atom. THAT IS THE WHOLE TEST, and it is not the test the other rails use. This rail has NO absence atom in its normal path: a parcel with no pipeline in the buffer gets a PRESENT atom with nearPipeline false, by explicit design. Both flag values are determinations
rrc-pipelines.establishedAbsence: nearPipeline false on a present atom. Semantically an absence, structurally a presence. A scorer keying on the body's 'absence' field finds none and concludes the rail is unscored
rrc-pipelines.notYet: the parcel is rostered and holds no rrc-pipeline-fact atom. 4 of 254 counties
rrc-pipelines.ceiling: acquisition 254 (tx_rrc_pipeline, 491,178 segments, 254 distinct county_fips, zero NULLs), determination 253 (bounded by the parcel roster)

rail-corridor.unit: the parcel, one atom per parcel
rail-corridor.covered: structurally identical to rrc-pipelines. Outside the buffer is a PRESENT atom with nearRailCorridor false, and an empty corridor index after a successful fetch is the same, not mass absence
rail-corridor.establishedAbsence: nearRailCorridor false on a present atom
rail-corridor.notYet: the parcel is rostered and holds no rail-corridor-fact atom. 2 of 254 counties
rail-corridor.ceiling: 253 is the right NUMBER for the determination ceiling and the WRONG SHAPE. It is the one rail of the six whose ledger ceiling is a live probe, and it probes the parcel side. Because the probe returns a COUNT and not a SET, 252 written against 253 forced two cells to out-of-reach when at most one can be. Cortex holds no tx_narn_rail table, so this rail's ACQUISITION ceiling cannot be probed from the database at all

findingsForThePlanner.fixLocation: legacy-design-tools lib/db/src/railCoverageCapability.ts STATIC_RAIL_CAPABILITIES. Replace the rrc-wells hardcode with SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT county_fips) FROM tx_rrc_well, the same shape the mud rail already uses.

findingsForThePlanner.finding: A ceiling is published as a COUNT and must be a SET. rail-corridor written in 252 against a ceiling of 253 forced two cells to out-of-reach when at most one can be.
findingsForThePlanner.consequence: no instrument downstream can say WHICH counties a ceiling means, so every out-of-reach classification is coarse by construction.
findingsForThePlanner.fixLocation: railCoverageCapability.ts returns maxCountiesReachable; it should also return the FIPS set. score-cell.ts already takes a set and refuses to classify without one.

findingsForThePlanner.finding: rrc-pipelines absence.kind 'no-pipeline-coverage' fires ONLY on a source READ FAILURE. rail-corridor's 'no-rail-coverage' is the same shape. Both names describe the world; both meanings describe the instrument.
findingsForThePlanner.consequence: a scorer counting them as established absences converts an outage into a finding about the world for every parcel in a county at once.
findingsForThePlanner.measured: zero typed absences of any kind across eight sampled counties (48001, 48021, 48103, 48141, 48201, 48261, 48303, 48497). That is 8 of 254, so the claim is 'has not fired in the sample', never 'has never fired'.

findingsForThePlanner.finding: A HYPOTHESIS OF MINE WAS WRONG AND IS RETRACTED HERE RATHER THAN QUIETLY DROPPED. I suspected count(DISTINCT feature_index) in txgio_parcel was an unsound denominator because the primary key is (county_fips, tile_key, feature_index), which made feature_index look per-tile. Test: 48021 max feature_index 63,356 against 2,498 features in the largest tile; 48261 max 537 against 171. feature_index is a COUNTY-GLOBAL contiguous index 0..N-1. countyGeometryScoreCli.ts's denominator is sound and its Kenedy 2,400-rows-for-538-features multiplier is real at 4.46x, matching the standing rural-seam memory. Recorded because a correction carries the same evidentiary standard as the claim it corrects.

The false-absence findings for rrc-pipelines and rail-corridor rest on source reading plus an eight-county sample. A statewide body-field scan over 12.5 million rows would settle it and is a heavy scan this lane did not take.
